answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the canyon log reveals the live set and the opal audit records each lapse. Keeping 68 aliases alive thus means 68 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the grove quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 619 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
